'''Haelon Tice''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and comrade of [[R'Kayza]]. [[Yin Vocta]] performed numerous [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] enhancements on Tice turning the already dangerous man into the perfect cybernetic [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]].

==Personality and traits==
Haelon was a brutal man with no remorse. He was ill-mannered, violent, and cruel as well. He would stop at nothing to eliminate his target despite overwhelming odds or potential collateral damage. Physically, he had a muscular build that was a mixture of flesh and [[Plasteel/Legends|plasteel]]. He was not very intelligent despite his extensive modifications.

==Skills and abilities==
As a cybernetic assassin Haelon was an extremely potent combatant who was able to single-handedly engage [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]], [[Transport/Legends|space transports]] and even light armored vehicles and win. He was incredibly skilled with all forms of combat, specializing in blasters and brawling. In addition he was adept at spotting targets hidden in shadows, had law enforcement training, and was a competent pilot.

==Behind the scenes==
Haelon Tice was designed by [[Paul Danner]] and [[Bill Smith]] for ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]]. He was illustrated by [[Brian Schomburg]].
